narr: A weak disturbance moved through Northeastern Pennsylvania, producing some showers and thunderstorms. Moisture was high in the atmosphere, and storms were very slow moving, resulting in areas of torrential rain and flash flooding.
ev: A section of Lehigh Road was washed out along Roaring Brook.

Water was reported over multiple roads around the Trucksville area. Many roads experienced damage from shoulder washouts. Sutton Road was washed out in a few locations and remained closed for more than a day.
Multiple roads in, and around, Sweet Valley had large rocks and debris deposited in the roadways from water overflow. Dobson Road was washed out in one location.
A section of the Drinker Turnpike was washed over with travel limited down to one lane. The fire department had to pump water off of the roadway.
